title: Singing cantiques at wakes
summary: Cantiques were sung in houses and at wakes through the night, not in church service.

story.theme_name: Church, faith and religion in a musician's life
story.community_name: Church, faith and jazz: the sacred and the secular

blocks.x: Under, where did you used to sing contits? Was it in church?
No, no. It was just the chorus or the priest and then that was upstairs. But in houses, or wakes, they used to sing contits. At wakes. At night, yes. Sing plenty.
The wakes would last all night.
Till four o'clock in the morning. Five o'clock in the morning.
